protocol: Compare both stop-rule endpoints under120/300s safety caps. Same200-iteration window and1e-6 threshold.300s reuses120s runs already stopped by plateau; only capped cases are rerun. These are not equal-time comparisons or96 fresh measurements.

protocol.includes: engine/table setup, search and stop checks; JIT warmed before each run
protocol.excludes: input loading/DP, warmup, saving, population diagnostics
protocol.concurrency: one process, one solve at a time; trajectories batched in a single GPU launch
protocol.diversity: exact archive equality (hash bucket collisions checked); 256 sampled distinct-index pairs; distance=sum(abs(y1-y2))/max(1,sum(y1)+sum(y2)), 0 identical, 1 disjoint flows
protocol.limits: two seeds per family; stop when all individual archives plateau; 120 s is a safety cap, not a convergence guarantee; not a hardware occupancy measurement
